name: auth_is_provider_explicitly_configured
notes: Explicit-config gate ladder (active_provider -> config model/moa -> registry env vars -> credential pool). Harness is a rung-for-rung traced copy of src/hermes_cli/auth_store.c::is_provider_explicitly_configured (the real port); disk/env state the port reads (auth.json active_provider + credential_pool, config.yaml tree, OPENAI_API_KEY) is materialized per-input by BOTH sides — the C harness applies the envspec via setenv/unsetenv and takes store/config as JSON inputs, while the LIVE twin writes a real tmpdir HERMES_HOME (auth.json + config.yaml) and sets real env vars before calling the live fn. Registry is a verbatim two-row mini-copy of provider_registry.c ('openai-api' api_key/{OPENAI_API_KEY}, 'nous' oauth_device_code) so only those providers are exercised. All 11 inputs MATCH, covering every ladder rung (empty-id, active_provider case-insensitive match, model.provider, moa refs/aggregator/presets, api_key env var usable + placeholder-rejected, oauth provider skips env rung, pool gh_cli-skipped/device_code-hit, env-backed pool entry).
